details.Known Concerns: Oil-injection condition, ignition modules, carburetors or EFI components, cooling corrosion, seized fasteners and lower-unit wear.
details.Inspect Before Valuing: Exact model/serial parts lookup, compression, oiling system, cold start, charging, cooling, gearcase oil, trim and on-water full-throttle test.
details.Great Lakes / Fit: Conditional • Potential value motor only when a local shop will support the exact DT model; otherwise discount for repower risk.

details.Audit / Notes: Running engine only; exact-model parts availability, corrosion and oil-injection condition control value.

details.Specs / Role: 70-115 • Low-pressure direct-injection 2-stroke
details.Features / Controls: Good for a 2-stroke; cleaner and quieter than carbureted two-strokes. • Low-speed trolling: Good when healthy; a kicker remains preferable for long trolling days.
details.Known Concerns: Air-compressor and air/fuel pressure faults, injectors, oiling system, sensors, corrosion and stale-fuel damage.
details.Inspect Before Valuing: Exact model/serial, diagnostic codes, compression, air and fuel pressures, oiling system, cold/hot restart, gearcase oil and water test.
details.Great Lakes / Fit: Conditional • Not an automatic rejection, but price it below a similarly clean mainstream four-stroke unless local TLDI service and parts support are confirmed.
details.Value Guidance: Enter motor year and exact HP
details.Audit / Notes: Running engine only; value assumes good compression and a clean TLDI-specific diagnostic/pressure check. Thin local legacy support should reduce package value.

details.Specs / Role: 50-150 • 4-stroke, carb or EFI
details.Features / Controls: Excellent economy; quiet and clean. • Low-speed trolling: Very good, especially EFI.
details.Known Concerns: Stale-fuel VST/injector issues, corrosion, overdue timing-belt service on applicable models.
details.Inspect Before Valuing: Compression/leak-down, belt history, cold start, charging, lower-unit oil, full-throttle RPM.
details.Great Lakes / Fit: Excellent • A clean example with records deserves a premium.
details.Value Guidance: Enter motor year and exact HP
details.Audit / Notes: Running take-out outboard only, controls/prop included; 2026 Great Lakes-region screening range. Service records, corrosion and exact hours can shift value substantially.

details.Specs / Role: 90-150 • High-pressure direct-injection 2-stroke
details.Features / Controls: Better than carbureted two-strokes; louder than four-strokes. • Low-speed trolling: Good when healthy, but a kicker remains preferable for extended trolling.
details.Known Concerns: High-pressure pump, injectors, multiple fuel filters, oiling system, carbon buildup and lean-running damage.
details.Inspect Before Valuing: Yamaha diagnostic history, compression/leak-down, high-pressure fuel service, injector records, oiling system, lower-unit oil and water test.
details.Great Lakes / Fit: Conditional • Do not pay Yamaha-four-stroke money merely because the cowling says Yamaha. HPDI needs records and a proper diagnostic check.
details.Value Guidance: Enter motor year and exact HP
details.Audit / Notes: Running outboard only; fuel-system documentation and diagnostic results determine whether it is a value or a trap.

details.Specs / Role: 70-150 • 2-stroke carbureted, oil injected
details.Features / Controls: Fair economy; loud and smoky by modern standards. • Low-speed trolling: Fair to good
details.Known Concerns: Oil injection, carb varnish, fuel pumps, corrosion, old hoses and ignition components.
details.Inspect Before Valuing: Compression, cold start, oiling inspection, carb sync, gearcase, charging.
details.Great Lakes / Fit: Good to very good • One of the more desirable old-school two-strokes if it passes inspection.
